entities.name: PMID:25076362
observations: Sun et al. reported that mPGES-2 knockout mice had markedly worse injury and mortality after a single 120 mg/kg intraperitoneal STZ dose than WT mice.
In STZ-treated knockout mice, hepatic GLUT2 increased approximately 50%; phloretin reduced excess STZ accumulation and hepatocyte injury, supporting but not proving GLUT2 mediation.

entities.name: PTGES2
observations: mPGES-2 deletion was associated with markedly worsened liver injury after STZ in mice; the reported mechanism involved increased hepatic GLUT2 and STZ accumulation.

entities.name: SLC2A2
observations: Hepatic GLUT2 expression was approximately 50% higher in STZ-treated mPGES-2 knockout mice; phloretin blunted increased cellular STZ accumulation and injury in primary hepatocytes, providing pharmacologic but not definitive genetic mediation evidence.

entities.name: Streptozotocin
observations: A single 120 mg/kg intraperitoneal dose was used to compare mPGES-2 knockout and WT mice in the reported liver injury study.
